questions.q: Put the goal clearance in order, from first to last.
options: Goalkeeper releases to the right ala
Right ala connects with the fixo
questions.explain: Yes. Release right, connect through the fixo, then switch left when the defender closes the right.
choiceExplanations: Yes. Release right, connect through the fixo, then switch left when the defender closes the right.

questions.q: Now the left ala receives the clearance. Drag the fixo to offer a safe pass.
questions.explain: Right. The fixo gives an open angle inside, away from the pressing blue pivot.
choiceExplanations: That is too far from the ball, and the pass would cross the whole court.

questions.q: This is a goal clearance. How does the goalkeeper send the ball out?
options: Throws or rolls it with the hands
questions.explain: Right. In futsal a goal clearance is thrown, and a roll is the easiest pass to control.
choiceExplanations: Right. In futsal a goal clearance is thrown, and a roll is the easiest pass to control.
